questions.questionText: 29) Which one of the following is a **scalar quantity**?
options: The total time taken to complete surgery.
The average velocity of airplane to travel.
Force applied on an object to change its place.
Displacement of an object to change its position.
questions.explanation:
A **scalar quantity** is defined by its **magnitude (size)** only. A **vector quantity** is defined by both its magnitude and its **direction**. 
- A: **Time** is a scalar quantity (only magnitude matters, not direction). 
- B: **Velocity** is a vector quantity (magnitude is speed, direction is required). 
- C: **Force** is a vector quantity (direction of application is required). 
- D: **Displacement** is a vector quantity (direction from starting point is required). (The word 'place' in C is often used interchangeably with 'position').
